reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown attribute Pahath-moab's small gap to the two registers being taken at different times and places, plus ordinary attrition.

discrepancy.note: Batten judges the Pahath-moab list entry, where the parallel census figures diverge, to be textually corrupt.

quotes.text: The text is corrupt, as the departure from the mechanical system of the list shows
quotes.attr: Loring W. Batten (d. 1946), A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on the Books of Ezra and Nehemiah (1913), on Ezra 2:6.
